goal: Remove intermittent 6-10 second homepage tab stalls without multiplying supplier traffic, preserve verified offer truth, publish once, and verify the exact public build on mobile and desktop.
predicted_rejections: A warm repeat is fast but the first real tab click still waits several seconds.
The UI looks responsive while duplicate API requests continue in the background.
The fix increases concurrent provider traffic and recreates the 524 incident.
Only mobile or only desktop is verified.
A local result is reported as public completion.

requirements.statement: Tab changes must not intermittently remain stuck for ten seconds.
requirements.acceptance_check: Fresh mobile and desktop public runs record every tested tab transition, exact build identity and API request count; no duplicated refreshing-to-verified pair remains in the ordinary successful path.

requirements.statement: The repair must not create an origin burst or weaken availability truth.
requirements.acceptance_check: One-at-a-time prefetch, shared in-flight promise, D1 lease ownership, verified-only caching and no-store refreshing/error paths pass focused tests.

requirements.statement: Only the exact cumulative source may be published and approved.
requirements.acceptance_check: Pushed commit, saved Sites version, terminal deployment, public build header and post-deploy browser report agree; v876 remains recorded rollback.

requirements.statement: Diagnose the Sites source credential project-not-found result after the exact project remained readable
requirements.acceptance_check: Inspect connector, authorized browser session, project CLI or API configuration and official Sites flow, then verify publication route recovery or an exact human-only dependency

evidence: Public v876 reproduction isolated 6469ms transition and duplicate response sequence
